# The www redirect's chkfail on retail 1.5b, connected, 2026-10-20: map
# mp_j5outpost (third-party nsf_mp_j5outpost.pk3 in the server's main/),
# `COD_VERSION=1.5 PORT=... tools/run_server.sh mp_j5outpost +set developer 1
# +set sv_wwwDownload 1 +set sv_wwwBaseURL '"http://127.0.0.1:<port>"' +set
# sv_wwwDlDisconnected 0`, another 129-byte pk3 under the map pak's name
# behind `python3 -m http.server`, and `vcod --net-probe ... --probe-download
# <scratch>` on an install without the map pak. One HTTP GET. The server
# streamed the re-request over UDP (only the first two block lines kept
# below; 467 block lines in all) and the pak landed with the listed
# checksum. Gate: www_download.rs a_chkfail_on_1_5_falls_back_to_udp.
